notes.title: Patch Notes 1022
notes.content:
Patch Note 1022

●New Chapter
Added a new chapter "The Abyss". We'll be waiting for you in the depths of the Abyss.

●Story
Added new cutscenes and endings that Gwihyang's story in more detail. As a result, all player data has been reset. We hope you enjoy the new story.

●Ghost Balance Adjustment
Overall ghost balance has been adjusted to allow for more diverse playstyles.

●New Ghost Added
A new ghost has been added to "The Abyss". Keep a close eye on this ghost with unique characteristics!

●Difficulty System Modified
Refined stamina reduction rates based on difficulty levels.
Adjusted item spawn probabilities.

●Other
Changed quickslot colors for better visibility.
Increased maximum frame limit from 144 to 300.
Changed the compass needle model.
Modified descriptions for some items.
Unlimited stamina is now available in the Secret Room.
Added highlight effects to important objects.
Fixed a bug that occurred when specific items spawned.
Fixed a bug related to talisman items.
Added player animation for game over

Please play after the update. Thank you.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0921
notes.content:
Patch Notes 0921

-Improved the physics engine.
-Added objects to the outdoor map.
-Added challenges upon clearing the Hard difficulty.
-Added a timer. Now you can press 'F7' to turn on the timer when playing on Hard difficulty.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0920
notes.content:
Patch Notes 0920

- Improved visibility for lighters and flashlights. Now you can see better when they flicker.
- Changed the color tone of flashlights.

notes.title: Hotfix 0919
notes.content:
Hotfix 0919

- Fixed animation bug for Pojol-gwi.
- Corrected text typos.
- Updated modeling for Geu-seun-sae in the Secret Room.

notes.title: Patch Note 0919
notes.content:
Patch Note 0919

- modified the difficulty level to make it even more difficult. I'm done with any more consideration.
- Fixed a ghost detection bug. Now the room is safer and it's more dangerous outside.
- Fixed Cha-ryun-gwi sound bug

notes.title: Patch Note 0918
notes.content:
Patch Note 0918

- The explanation of ghosts in the secret room was changed.
- The explanation fonts and brightness in the secret room was changed.
- changed ghost model in the secret room.
- modified some bugs

notes.title: Patch Note 0917
notes.content:
Patch Note 0917

- Tutorial skip feature added. No more tutorials needed on initial clear.
- Sitting key added. You can now sit with the control key!
- We added an outline to a specific item to make it visible even in the dark.
- Fixed the Spawn item acquisition range. Items are now picked up better.

- changed the sound of the wheel ghost.
- Fixed a bug in the drawer.
- I adjusted the font size of the secret room.

Thank you.

notes.title: Hotfix 0916
notes.content:
Hotfix 0916

Patch History
- Fix what happens when the game stops after loading the game
- Modify the phenomenon of a text story stopping in progress

Workaround in case of a bug that stops
Win + R -> %AppData% Search -> LocalLow -> Delete GrooveDev folder and rerun game

Thank you.

notes.title: July 7th Gwihyang : Homecoming Development Details
notes.content:
July 7th Gwihyang : Homecoming Development Details

1. Added difficulty adjustment function

Added easy, normal, and hard difficult settings.
Each difficulty level determines the number of monsters and traps and the number of items.

The basic difficulty level is recommended as normal.

2. Add Japanese, Chinese, and Russian

We added new languages.
Enjoy your Gwihyang in various languages!

3. New monster Chang-gwi

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069380/deb66a902ff6b48f37b4cb1f415ad707e93a462f.png

We are currently developing a Chang-gwi.
It will be applied to the game as soon as the modeling is completed.

Thank you to everyone who has been waiting.
